candidates.title: How to Meet 1,500 Artists in 5 Days at Upstate Art Weekend
candidates.summary: Upstate Art Weekend, starting Thursday, brings together New York artists and audiences, and offers everything from icebergs to Arte Povera to keep you cool.

candidates.title: ‘Romería’ Review: What Actually Happened to Her Parents?
candidates.summary: In this semi-autobiographical drama, a young woman in Spain whose birth parents died of AIDS-related illnesses faces a complicated reunion with her extended family.

candidates.title: ‘Lucky Strike’ Review: Fighting a Battle Behind Enemy Lines
candidates.summary: This World War II movie is a nuts-and-bolts survival thriller that recalls a bygone era of Greatest Generation patriotism.

candidates.title: ‘Drunken Noodles’ Review: Saucy Encounters
candidates.summary: Over two blurred summers, an intern at an art gallery experiences solitude and pleasure with the men he encounters.

candidates.title: ‘Couture’ Review: No Common Thread
candidates.summary: Angelina Jolie plays a woman preparing for a Paris runway show in Alice Winocour’s fragmentary look at the rarefied world of high fashion.

candidates.title: ‘Bouchra’ Review: All Too Human
candidates.summary: In this 3-D animation, a New Yorker who’s also a coyote tries to come to terms with her mother while working on an autobiographical movie.
